id./param/scenario/cs/a_170_cs_140.pack|cs_: "Queen Frysabel! Step away from her! She says her powers are lost, but she is a witch! It is in her nature to lie!
"Everyone, listen to me! Krystalinda did something unforgivable when she froze this city...
"When she held me captive, we spoke from time to time. She even helped me understand what it is to be queen...
"Hers is not a bad heart. And the time I spent in the book gave me the chance to think, to ready myself to truly rule at last.
"Please, I believe her when she says her powers are spent. She is not a threat any longer. We must let her live.
"She seems convinced, Snorri. Why not give Krystalinda one last chance?
"Very well. You are the ruler of this kingdom, Your Majesty. If that is your decision, we will gladly follow it.
"Hmph! Must you be so nicey-nicey, Frysabel? You're making me look bad...
"Krystalinda, there's something I still don't understand. Why did ye freeze Sniflheim in the first place?
"Oh, that was a favour for a friend. The splendid specimen who released me from the grimoire...
"As you know, I was trapped in that dusty, fusty library for a horribly long time. It was so, so boring!
"Then, three months ago, he appeared. He took down my book from the shelf and spoke to me...
"I will release you from your prison. But you must do something for me in return.
"For a beautiful boy like you? Anything! Free me, and I am yours forever more. What is your desire, my pretty?
"You must freeze Sniflheim. A great hero will be sent to save the city, one who wears the same pendant as I.
"His name is Hendrik. And when he arrives, I would like you to kill him.
"So I did. When the hero arrived, I had him run an errand first: slay a mighty beast that had stolen my powers.
"The same pendant as Sir Hendrik, eh? And what was this handsome young fellow's name, might I ask?
"His name? Oh, I haven't a clue. He vanished after he freed me. It's a shame, he was such a pretty little thing...
"Hmm...
"Thank you once again for all you have done for me and my kingdom. The Orb is yours to do with as you see fit.
{var:1} received the Blue Orb!
"But Your Majesty, isn't the Orb one of your kingdom's most precious treasures? Are you sure you don't mind?
"Of course! As my father always said, the true treasure of this kingdom is its people, and you saved them.
"Well, if you insist! Best of luck with your royal duties, and try not to let the pressure get to you, okay?
"Oh, don't worry about that, little girl. Frysabel will be just fine. I plan to take very good care of her!
